question.instructions: Which part of Ruff (a Python linter and formatter) does this issue concern? Classify by the behavior or feature being requested or reported. Use the affected component as the main signal: lint-rule behavior and fixes belong to linter, code layout belongs to formatter, and LSP-specific behavior and settings belong to server.

criteria.linter: Lint rules, new checks, detection coverage, false positives, rule-specific fixes, suppression comments (noqa), import sorting, and docstring checks. Requests to detect redundant, deprecated, or problematic Python code belong here, including requests without a rule code.
criteria.formatter: Code layout and style produced by the formatter, such as spacing, indentation, line wrapping, and quote layout.
criteria.server: The language server (LSP), editor integration, and editor-specific settings, including how the server discovers, prioritizes, or applies configuration.
criteria.configuration: General Ruff settings, configuration files, command-line options and behavior, and selecting or enabling rules. Includes how users configure Ruff across CLI workflows.
